title: anogra pallida var. runcinata
intro: Anogra pallida var. runcinata, commonly known as Anogera pallida, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae, native to the Mediterranean region. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Anogera pallida include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
